scenario: Vulnerable Cronjob Configurations - Cronjob Wildcard Injection
data_flow: fixturefiles creates/renames inbox filename -> bare * in cron cwd -> expanded argv -> option branch in fixture-maintenance.c -> predefined stdout diagnostic
limitations: The runner emulates the fixed cron command and wildcard expansion without a shell, daemon or UID transition. CWE-78 and CWE-269 describe the modeled command/privilege boundary; no command execution or privilege escalation is implemented. File contents are never read.
